images.title: Start with the units column
images.purpose: Shows how the units column fixes B and the carry fixes A in A1 + 1B = B0.
images.composition: Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no characters, no extra text. One column addition in the centre with the units column highlighted, and the solved sum at the right.
images.exact_structure: Left, a column addition in large type: top row A1, second row + 1B, a rule, answer row B0, digits aligned in a tens column and a units column. The units column has a pale reddish purple (#CC79A7) band behind it. A small amber (#E69F00) 1 sits above the tens column as the carry. Beside the units band: B = 9. Beside the tens column: A = 7. Right, in a teal (#0072B2) box: 71 + 19 = 90. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: 1 + B ends in 0, so B is 9 with a carry of 1, and then A + 1 + 1 = 9 gives A = 7.

image_decisions.why: A column layout with the units column marked shows where to start a cryptarithm.
